name: Utah Speedcubing Pride 2025
information: All proceeds of this competition will go to [The Trevor Project](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/) This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahSpeedcubingPride2025#58196-cubing-club-at-uvu). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
